text_block_list.text:
—One day off. It had been raining since 
morning, leaving the sky dim and dreary 
despite it being midday.
choice_data_list:
(Maybe I should check out some race 
footage...)

text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to enter the trainer's 
office—
choice_data_list: （レース映像でもチェックしようかな……）

text_block_list.text:
The lights are off. Is nobody here? Did I 
forget to lock up, by any chance—
choice_data_list: あれっ、鍵が開いてる……？

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: Universe!?

text_block_list.text:
"To think she was crouching here all 
alone... Could she be feeling unwell!?"
choice_data_list: ユニヴァース！？

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――? Neo Universe's "value" is an "absolute 
magnitude"... It hasn't fluctuated.
choice_data_list: 大丈夫！？

text_block_list.text:
Her color looks fine. Judging by her 
puzzled expression... it doesn't seem like 
she's feeling unwell.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...'Exploring' the lingering echoes of 
Apollo. To reach 'serenity'... one must 
gather 'rain,' 'sound,' and 'dimness'...—

—Just then, I noticed music playing from 
the smartphone in her hand.
choice_data_list: ...Were you listening to music?
...Were you listening to music?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Will Trainer "listen" as 
well?
choice_data_list: ……音楽、聴いてたのか？
……音楽、聴いてたの？

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Progressive rock. It's music played by a 
'band.'"

—It's a delicate, futuristic piece. 
Despite its intricate, complex 
progression, the notes seem to sparkle and 
shine...
choice_data_list: So you like this genre.
You like this genre, huh?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. I can say... "like," 
"favorite."
choice_data_list: こういうジャンルが好きなんだな
こういうジャンルが好きなんだね
choice_data_list_en: So you like this genre, huh.
You like this genre, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Recollection. With Papa... because we 
'listened' "frequently"—

text_block_list.name: Young Universe
text_block_list.text:
Rain... "ASEM" —Is Papa having a 
"rendezvous" with research? Shall we do a 
"hole up"?

text_block_list.name: Universe's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Um... "A rendezvous with research"... 
Does she mean she's completely tied up 
with research? ...No, depending on what 
"ASEM" means...

text_block_list.name: Young Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Ah. This sound... exists in my "reception 
logs"... A sound of someone's "love" from 
long ago...

text_block_list.name: Universe's Father
text_block_list.text:
—! Ah, Papa likes it too. It's 
intellectual and sparkling... What a 
lovely sound.

text_block_list.name: Young Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Twinkle"... Uni "senses" it too. It's the 
sound of the universe, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Universe's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, the sounds of space, huh? It 
certainly has a very futuristic, romantic 
ring to it—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—On rainy days... Dad always 'listens' to 
this in his study...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe "shared" too. —I was able to 
"connect" with Papa.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Rain", "sound", "memories"... 
Everything's in place.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —The "coldness" fades away...

The music she often listened to with her 
father on rainy days. That must be a 
soothing balm for her, and a cherished 
memory.
choice_data_list: ...It's a song full of memories, huh.
...It's a song full of memories, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"‘Memories’... "MABTE". ‘Peace of mind’ is 
being "sensed"...—"
choice_data_list: ……思い出の曲なんだな
……思い出の曲なんだね
choice_data_list_en: ...That's a song full of memories for you, huh.
...That's a song full of memories for you, isn't it?

text_block_list.text:
"Closing her eyes, Neo Universe listened 
intently to the song. This music might be 
something like a source of energy for 
her."
choice_data_list:
Let's recharge our batteries with this and 
get back to work.

I wonder if there's a way to make it even 
more relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Recharging energy"... In other words, 
"replenishment"... and "sedation."
choice_data_list: これで元気チャージして、また頑張ろう
さらに安らげる方法はないかな
choice_data_list_en: Let's recharge with this and keep giving it our best.
I wonder if there's a way to make this even more relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
In that case... I have just the right 
"energy" for you.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: This band's album.
choice_data_list: Sounds good, I'd love to listen.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Contents: 10 songs. ...That means "plenty 
of time to relax."
choice_data_list: いいね、聴いてみたい
choice_data_list_en: Sounds good, I'd love to hear it.

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while drinking warm tea 
together, we leisurely looked through the 
photo album.

If we could visually immerse ourselves in 
the world of this music through videos, 
for instance, wouldn't our memories of it 
become all the more vivid?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Video... Neo Universe lacks 'records.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
With this terminal, "possible"? Commencing 
"exploration"—
choice_data_list:
Ah, looks like there's a streaming service 
for it.

Ah, looks like there's a streaming service 
available.

text_block_list.text:
"It seems you can watch live performance 
videos of this band online. Playing the 
video—"
choice_data_list: あ、配信サービスがあるみたいだな
あ、配信サービスがあるみたいだね
choice_data_list_en: Oh, looks like there's a streaming service.
Oh, looks like there's a streaming service.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Sfera. ...Papa always does the 'humming.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This one has... dense "records." What I 
"rented"... with Papa... "FFTI."

And so, as Neo Universe slowly shared bits 
and pieces of her memories, we spent a 
leisurely time watching the live 
performance video.
